reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
1. 
- A large number of individuals hold the view that financial resources play a vital role in the attainment of personal well-being.
- It is widely considered by many that wealth is among the most crucial elements for securing a happy life.
- Few would deny that having a shortage of money rarely brings fulfillment, whereas accumulation of wealth is often deemed paramount in reaching happiness.

2. 
- While some argue that expanding athletic infrastructure is the most optimal approach to enhance community wellness, others contend that such a measure will yield negligible results.
- It is claimed by some that public health can be most effectively elevated through the proliferation of sports venues, though opposing voices suggest this strategy would make a minimal difference.
- The augmentation of recreational sports centers is viewed by certain groups as the ultimate solution for better population health, whereas alternative opinions maintain that this action may barely cause any notable changes.
reviews.overall: Em đã làm đủ sáu câu và ba cách viết trong mỗi nhóm có thay đổi cấu trúc thật. Tuy nhiên, ở câu thứ nhất, “vital role” và “paramount” không giữ chính xác ý “một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất”. Ở câu thứ hai, “ultimate solution” làm mạnh hơn ý “cách tốt nhất”. Em sửa ba chỗ này, rồi soát lại để mọi bản đều giữ đúng mức nghĩa gốc.

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is true that advertisements have become an increasingly common feature of our daily lives. While this trend has certain drawbacks, I believe that it is a development with both positive and negative aspects.
From consumers' perspective, commercials bring a truly convenient and helpful buying experience. Unlike decades ago, when people largely relied on local brands, nowadays, TV advertisements, pop-ups on social networking platforms, and street billboards expose people to a wide range of goods available on the market. Because of this, consumers can make wiser purchasing choices and decisions. On a far wider societal scale, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. Advertisements featuring engaging content and appealing visual effects stimulate customers' demand and purchasing power. This leads to an increase in production, more employment opportunities, and more revenue poured into the state budget.
However, this development also has significant drawbacks, notably the fact that advertising can lead to wasteful spending. Persuasive advertisements often lure or entice people into buying things they may not otherwise need. Because this tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities who hold strong social influence, the promoted products are made to look more trustworthy and desirable. As a result, consumers are driven into impulsive and wasteful buying habits and behaviors regardless of whether these celebrities are actually fans of the products. Additionally, the sheer volume of advertisements with their colossal numbers can feel overwhelming and annoying to the audience. Social network users, in fact, have frequently showcased their frustration about being constantly and incessantly bombarded with pop-ups of all types, which acutely disrupt their online experience while gaming or watching films, as they are simply failed to be turned off until half a minute later.
In conclusion, while the proliferation of advertisements brings undeniable benefits to consumers in terms of shopping choices and acts as a catalyst for economic growth, it also triggers wasteful spending and causes annoyance to the public. Therefore, I consider this trend to be a mixed development containing both positive and negative consequences.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is sometimes argued that news agencies should feature a higher proportion of positive stories. While I acknowledge that broadcasting uplifting events offers certain benefits, I completely disagree with this proposal.
Admittedly, reporting good news more frequently offers certain advantages. In a way, such a trend allows people to adopt more optimistic perspectives on the world and life. This can be seen in the inspiring story of Nick Vujicic, a man born without arms and legs who became a world-famous motivational speaker. Despite facing many challenges, he chose not to give up and now travels around the world to inspire others. However, such a proposal fails to consider the feasibility of this policy. Human beings are, by nature, drawn to breaking or shocking news, such as political scandals or natural disasters. Consequently, an overabundance of good news would fail to attract viewers or readers, thereby negatively affecting news agencies’ profitability and making bankruptcy expected.
Apart from financial survival, bad news is actually beneficial because it constantly warns people of existing and looming problems in society. To illustrate, consider a piece of news on a tragic accident where a family of four lost their lives because the father was driving under the influence of alcohol. If people are constantly exposed to this kind of news, they are much more likely to avoid drunk driving or try to dissuade their friends or relatives from doing so. This shows how, by reporting tragic deaths caused by dangerous driving, media companies help the public circumvent countless problems in life.
In conclusion, although positive stories can foster optimism among the public, I firmly believe that the media must continue to report a balanced mix of news, including negative events, to maintain public interest and serve as vital warnings for society.

Hai ví dụ đều đúng nguồn, nhưng sau chuyện Nick em cần nói rõ người tiếp nhận tin ấy có thể lạc quan hơn. reviews.suggestedRevision:
It is sometimes argued that news agencies should feature a higher proportion of positive stories. While I acknowledge that reporting uplifting events offers certain benefits, I firmly believe that giving them more coverage is an unwise proposal.
Admittedly, reporting good news more frequently offers certain advantages. In a way, such coverage allows people to adopt more optimistic perspectives on the world and life. This can be seen in the story of Nick Vujicic, a man born without arms and legs who became a world-famous motivational speaker. Despite facing many challenges, he chose not to give up and now travels around the world to inspire others; hearing his story may encourage people to face their own difficulties more positively. However, such a proposal fails to consider its practicality. Human beings are, by nature, often drawn to breaking or shocking news, such as political scandals or natural disasters. Increasing the share of good news could therefore make it harder for news agencies to attract viewers or readers, reducing their profitability and potentially leading to bankruptcy.
Apart from this practical concern, reporting bad news is beneficial because it warns people of existing and looming problems in society. To illustrate, consider a piece of news about a tragic accident in which a family of four lost their lives because the father was driving under the influence of alcohol. If people are regularly exposed to this kind of news, they are much more likely to avoid drunk driving or try to dissuade their friends or relatives from doing so. This shows how, by reporting tragic deaths caused by dangerous driving, media companies can warn the public about serious risks in life.
In conclusion, although positive stories can foster optimism, I remain convinced that giving positive stories more coverage would be unwise because reports of negative events attract audiences and provide vital warnings.

reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
While some researchers advocate for sending signals into space to make contact with extraterrestrial intelligent life forms, others argue that doing so is ill-advised and hazardous. In my view, I completely agree with the second perspective that attempting to contact alien civilizations is extremely dangerous.
Admittedly, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets. There are currently many problems facing our world that seem to be insoluble, such as global warming, rising sea levels, and animal extinction, which will eventually lead to the demise of our own race. Therefore, contacting alien civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems could perhaps result in them passing on their invaluable knowledge to help us avoid our extinction.
However, I firmly believe that this is a bad idea due to the immense risks involved. Our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration, which can be seen in the fact that we have not yet been able to send manned missions to Mars. If we manage to reach out, any civilization capable of traveling to Earth would possess a technology that far exceeds ours. Consequently, they would have little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity, except for using us as their test subjects. Furthermore, because of their superior technology, we would be rendered entirely helpless against their possible invasion.
In conclusion, although establishing contact with extraterrestrial life might offer potential solutions to our global crises through advanced knowledge, the severe risks—ranging from technological inferiority to the threat of a devastating invasion—make it a dangerous endeavor. Therefore, I strongly agree that sending messages into space is an unwise choice.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ 276 từ, bàn cả hai quan điểm và giữ đúng các chuỗi ý Cô giao: lợi ích tri thức ở Body 1, hai nguy cơ riêng ở Body 2. Cô ghi nhận cách em dùng câu bị động và từ chỉ khả năng đúng chỗ. Em cần bỏ cách nêu quan điểm hai lần trong cùng câu mở bài và báo rõ lý do đầu sau câu chủ đề Body 2. Kết bài cũng nên chốt quan điểm trong một câu để tránh lặp.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued by some that pervasive advertising campaigns can have detrimental impacts on consumers.This essay will, accordingly, provide insights into the negative ways commercials affect individuals and the potential solutions that can be implemented to minimize these issues.
There are two main ways in which advertising can negatively affect people. Firstly, consumers are constantly bombarded with a massive amount of marketing content every day, which leads to information overload. Secondly, many commercial campaigns tend to exaggerate the functions of their goods. As a result, people are easily manipulated into buying things they do not truly need, leading to financial waste.
To minimize its harmful effects, governments should adopt several measures. First and foremost, authorities must impose strict censorship on all advertisements. To be specific, rigorous content checks must be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that the product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality. Furthermore, there should be a restriction on the number of platforms on which a company is permitted to market its products. Implementing this policy would effectively protect consumers against information overload and help them avoid making unnecessary purchases.
In conclusion, advertising can negatively impact individuals by overwhelming them with information and misleading them into impulsive buying, however, these problems can be effectively tackled if governments enforce rigorous censorship and restrict the platforms used for marketing.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời đúng hai câu hỏi, chia rõ đoạn tác hại và đoạn giải pháp, đồng thời dùng tín hiệu chuyển giữa hai ý trong mỗi đoạn. Tuy nhiên, bài mới có 224 từ, dưới mức tối thiểu 250 từ; một số chuỗi lập luận còn đi thẳng từ ý chính đến kết quả. Em cần giải thích tác động của quảng cáo lặp lại, cách lời giới thiệu phóng đại dẫn tới mua thừa, và cách từng biện pháp làm giảm đúng tác hại ấy. Sau đó, em sửa lỗi dấu câu ở mở và kết bài rồi nộp lại bài đủ độ dài.

“Information overload” mới là tên tác hại; em chưa cho thấy các quảng cáo lặp lại làm gián đoạn việc người xem đang làm như thế nào. “Constantly” và “every day” cũng lặp ý về tần suất.

Chiến dịch quảng cáo không sở hữu “their goods”; điều em muốn nói là quảng cáo thổi phồng lợi ích của sản phẩm được quảng bá. “Functions” chỉ chức năng cụ thể nên không bao quát đúng ý này.

Em đã nêu hậu quả mua đồ không cần thiết, nhưng chưa giải thích lời quảng cáo phóng đại khiến sản phẩm có vẻ hữu ích hơn thực tế ra sao. “People are easily manipulated” cũng khẳng định quá rộng.

These claims can make products seem more useful than they really are. As a result, some consumers may buy things they do not need and waste money.

anchors.quote: As a result, people are easily manipulated into buying things they do not truly need, leading to financial waste.

annotations.title: Nối biện pháp với tác hại đã nêu
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Em nêu đúng biện pháp kiểm tra nội dung trước khi phát hành; cần thêm bước giải thích vì sao thông tin chính xác giúp người mua tránh các tuyên bố phóng đại và cân nhắc món hàng.

To be specific, rigorous content checks should be carried out before advertisements are released so that product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality. This would make exaggerated claims less likely to reach consumers and help them judge whether a purchase is necessary.

anchors.quote: To be specific, rigorous content checks must be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that the product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality.

annotations.label: a6
annotations.title: Giải thích tác dụng của giới hạn nền tảng
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“This policy” chỉ rõ việc giới hạn nền tảng, nhưng em đi thẳng từ biện pháp đến hai kết quả. Ý tránh mua không cần thiết cũng là gợi ý trong bài học; em cần cho thấy ít tiếp xúc với thông điệp thuyết phục hơn có thể giảm mua bốc đồng, thay vì khẳng định chắc chắn.

If fewer platforms carry a company's advertisements, consumers may encounter them in fewer parts of their online routine and feel less overwhelmed. Reduced exposure to persuasive messages could also make impulsive purchases less likely.

anchors.quote: Implementing this policy would effectively protect consumers against information overload and help them avoid making unnecessary purchases.

annotations.title: Dấu phẩy nối hai câu độc lập

Trước và sau “however” đều là mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh, nên không thể chỉ ngăn bằng dấu phẩy. Em cần tách thành hai câu hoặc dùng dấu chấm phẩy trước “however”.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
While some people argue that playing video games is a harmless form of entertainment or an educational tool, others maintain that it exerts negative effects on players. Although such development is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages that it offers are far more pronounced.
Admittedly, this trend can bring more merits. Chief of these is that video games can serve as an effective tool for relaxation after stressful working or studying hours. Added to this is that certain strategic or educational games can help improve players' problem-solving skills, hand-eye coordination, and quick decision-making abilities. However, these benefits are relatively limited and superficial compared to the broader consequences.
However, I believe that the substantial detriments far outweigh the positives. Initially, excessive gaming often leads to a sedentary lifestyle, which significantly increases the risk of physical health problems such as obesity, chronic fatigue, and severe vision impairment. Moreover, spending too much time in virtual worlds can result in social isolation and a lack of real-life communication skills. Many young players might even become addicted, leading to poor academic performance or neglected responsibilities in their daily lives.
In conclusion, although it is true that video games may bring about a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
reviews.overall: Em đã nêu rõ quan điểm rằng tác hại của trò chơi điện tử lớn hơn lợi ích, và bài có hai đoạn thân đúng hướng. Tuy nhiên, Body 1 mới kể lợi ích mà chưa giải thích trải nghiệm trong thế giới ảo, cách rèn kỹ năng và vì sao hoạt động khác có thể thay thế các lợi ích ấy. Body 2 nêu hậu quả nhưng thiếu chuỗi điểm thưởng, cảm giác thành tựu, chơi lâu rồi nghiện; ví dụ trẻ chơi để vượt cấp hoặc hơn bạn cũng chưa có. Bài hiện có 220 từ, thiếu 30 từ so với mức tối thiểu 250; em cần phát triển đúng các bước này rồi nộp lại.

While some people argue that playing video games is a harmless form of entertainment or an educational tool, others maintain that it can have negative effects on players. Although gaming can offer some benefits, I believe that its drawbacks are far more pronounced.
Admittedly, video games can offer both recreational and educational benefits. Chief of these is that they can help players relax after stressful hours at work or school. Players are transported into virtual worlds where they can engage in high-risk races or fictional battles without real-life danger, experiencing a sense of novelty and excitement that a few real-life pastimes can offer. Additionally, when players must continually devise strategies to win, they can develop problem-solving, teamwork and decision-making skills. However, these gains are relatively limited because similar skills can be developed through team sports or debate clubs. Such activities can offer further benefits without exposing young people to the same risks of addiction or physical inactivity.
More seriously, I believe that the substantial detriments far outweigh the positives because video games can be highly addictive. Players are often given scores, new targets and frequent rewards, making them feel that they are achieving something whenever they progress. For example, children may spend hours progressing through a game's levels or trying to score more points than their friends. This prolonged pursuit can become an addiction. As a result, young players may lose sleep, suffer deteriorating eyesight and adopt a sedentary lifestyle, potentially increasing their risk of obesity. Schoolwork may also suffer when homework is sacrificed for a few more hours on a gaming console. These health and academic costs carry more weight than the recreational and educational gains, especially when those gains can be obtained through other activities.
In conclusion, although video games may offer excitement and useful skills, the risk of addiction and its effects on health and schoolwork make their drawbacks more significant.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
The growing accessibility of remote and natural environments, such as the South Pole, for scientists and tourists has become a subject of considerable discussion. From my perspective, this trend brings both advantages and disadvantages.
On the one hand, traveling to remote areas is beneficial to a certain extent. Initially, it offers researchers unprecedented opportunities to conduct field studies in pristine ecosystems, helping humanity gain deeper insights into climate change, geology, and unique wildlife conservation. Furthermore, expanding tourism to these isolated regions can boost local economies and raise public awareness about environmental protection, as visitors witness firsthand the fragile beauty of nature.
On the other hand, the negative impacts of opening up these remote destinations are evident. Firstly, human presence and tourism activities inevitably disrupt delicate ecosystems, leading to habitat destruction, pollution, and disturbance to native species that are unaccustomed to human interference. In addition, increasing commercial travel to extreme locations requires heavy resource consumption and increases carbon emissions, which ironically exacerbates the very global warming issues that scientists are trying to study.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that while traveling to remote natural areas provides notable scientific and educational benefits, its potential environmental drawbacks should not be underestimated.
reviews.overall: Em đã tự diễn đạt lại bối cảnh đề và viết được các câu khá rõ, nhưng bài đi sai dàn ý: Cô giao khẳng định đây là sự phát triển có lợi, Body 1 nói về khách du lịch và Body 2 nói về nhà khoa học. Em lại viết một đoạn lợi, một đoạn hại; phần lớn ví dụ và chuỗi giải thích được giao chưa xuất hiện. Bài có 199 từ, thiếu 51 từ so với mức tối thiểu 250 từ. Cô yêu cầu em viết lại hai đoạn thân theo đúng chuỗi ý và nộp lại.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The growing accessibility of remote and natural environments, such as the South Pole, for scientists and tourists has become a subject of considerable discussion. I am firmly convinced that this development is positive because it offers travellers unfamiliar experiences and helps researchers address scientific problems.
For tourists, access to remote destinations can make travel more rewarding. No matter how many attractions there are elsewhere, many travellers still crave novelty. When they visit an island unknown to most people, they may participate in unfamiliar religious practices of indigenous communities, see rarely encountered plants and animals, try new food and experience a different way of life. These encounters offer experiences that ordinary trips cannot always provide. Granted, one might argue that these things can be seen on television channels devoted to travel. However, watching them on a screen is far less engaging than experiencing the activities in person.
Remote exploration can also benefit scientists by expanding what is known about the natural world. Regardless of how much has already been discovered, many scientific questions remain unanswered. Visiting hard-to-reach places allows researchers to investigate phenomena that may help them solve present and future problems. For example, new viruses emerge from time to time, while global warming affects elusive animals and their habitats in dense forests and deep seas. By studying these phenomena, scientists can better understand the risks and prepare for potential outbreaks that could kill millions of people. Their findings can also guide efforts through which damaged habitats can be restored. This knowledge may therefore protect both human lives and vulnerable ecosystems.
In conclusion, I believe that the new possibility of reaching remote natural areas is a positive development, as it gives tourists distinctive firsthand experiences and enables scientists to respond more effectively to emerging problems.
